title: RP3G
tagline: It is a WIP but I am creating a game to practice my skills in Web3
description: I want to make a RPG that other users can communicate with each other, and have information on the game written to the blockchain with visible rewards.  It is my first time making a game and I want to see if I can do it.  There is a lot to be added, but this is my first time making a game.
how_its_made: It is based on the MERN stack and will be on the Ethereum Network.  I want to make something that I can practice my skills on.  I want to create a game that people want to play and compete each other with and win awards.  I have a couple ideas in mind that I still want to implement.
